subject: general
question: In which of the following years was the Swarnjayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY) launched with the aim to bring the assisted poor families (Swarozgaris) above the poverty line by organising them into Self Help Groups (SHGs) through a mix of bank credit and government subsidies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1999**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Swarnjayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY)** was **launched in 1999** by the Government of India as a major initiative to promote self-employment in rural areas.
 
• The primary objective of the scheme was to bring **assisted poor families (Swarozgaris)** above the poverty line by providing them with income-generating assets and resources.
 
• It emphasized the formation of **Self-Help Groups (SHGs)**, encouraging collective efforts among rural poor families for economic development.
 
• The scheme was implemented through a **mix of bank credit and government subsidies**, ensuring financial aid for entrepreneurial ventures.
 
• SGSY focused on **key activities** like skill development, capacity building, and marketing support to ensure the sustainability of self-employment initiatives.
 
• It was eventually restructured into the **National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM)** in 2011, which continues to empower rural communities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Key Features of SGSY:**

 
 
• SGSY focused on the **holistic development** of rural households by combining resources like subsidies, credit, and training facilities.
 
• The scheme targeted the **Below Poverty Line (BPL)** population and assisted them in engaging in productive economic activities.
 
• It emphasized the **formation of activity-based clusters** to enhance economies of scale and provide better market linkages for rural products.
 
• Special attention was given to vulnerable sections like **women, Scheduled Castes (SCs), Scheduled Tribes (STs),** and disabled individuals.
 
• Financial assistance under SGSY comprised **75% subsidy** by the government and the remaining 25% as a contribution from beneficiaries.
 
 
 
• **National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM):**
 
 
• In 2011, SGSY was restructured into NRLM, also known as **Aajeevika**, to strengthen rural livelihoods further.
 
• NRLM aims to create **efficient and effective institutional platforms** for the rural poor to improve their access to financial services and sustainable livelihoods.
 
• The mission focuses on enabling poor households to access **livelihood opportunities** and participate in the growth process of the economy.
 
• It promotes **self-reliance** among rural communities through participatory approaches and capacity-building initiatives.
 
 
 
• **Self-Help Groups (SHGs):**
 
 
• SHGs are small, informal groups of individuals (usually women) that come together for **mutual support** and economic empowerment.
 
• They pool their resources, provide small loans to members, and work collectively towards their shared goals.
 
• SHGs play a crucial role in **financial inclusion** by facilitating access to credit and savings for the rural poor.
 
• These groups also serve as platforms for skill development, entrepreneurship, and social change.
 
 
 
• **Rural Development in India:**
 
 
• India has undertaken numerous initiatives to address rural poverty and unemployment, including schemes like **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)** and **Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana (DAY-NRLM).**
 
• These programs aim to provide **livelihood opportunities**, enhance skills, and promote entrepreneurship in rural areas.
 
• The focus is on improving the **socio-economic status** of marginalized communities and fostering inclusive growth.
